messages:
Ari: Quick check — does vendor-zephyr have 4 A100s spare for a short demo tomorrow 06:00-09:00 PST? Need ~3h. Also pinging @Maya for cost approval.
Maya: Finance can greenlight a one-off if it’s tagged to RED-231. Send tenant/project and rough estimate.
Ari: Project: demo-redwood-plugin (tenant=red-demo-23). Rough cost calc: 4 x A100 @ ~$2.8/hr spot -> ~ $33.6 + vendor fees.
ProcurementJoe: Pinged vendor-zephyr sales, awaiting allocation confirmation. Should have a reply within ~2h.
Lucas: Quick quota check — our us-west2 account shows 6 free A100 slots but 2 are reserved by nightly-bench. You can claim 4 if we retag reservations.
Sasha: If we borrow those, I’ll update the TF allocation. Snippet to add label: ```resource "gpu_allocation" "demo" {
  region = "us-west2"
  model  = "A100"
  count  = 4
  tags   = ["demo/overnight","team/demo-redwood"]
}```
Ari: Do we need any manual approvals to retag/borrow?
Lucas: Need Maya to approve charge (cc), and Sasha to apply TF. Also need Jordan to review/merge the quota PR (#4523).
Jordan: I’ll review PR now. Please hold label changes until I confirm no conflict with nightly-bench; if there is conflict I’ll propose reducing to 3 GPUs and shifting to 05:00-08:00.
ProcurementJoe: Vendor replied — can allocate 4 A100s in us-west2 for 06:00-09:00 PST, rate confirmed. They require PO number by EOD to lock the slots.
Ari: Maya — can finance issue a PO once procurement has an invoice draft?
Maya: I can issue PO if procurement produces invoice draft and cc finance@redwood. ProcurementJoe, please create draft.
DeployBot: Scheduled canary note — RED-231 demo will attempt warmup at 2026-03-22 06:30 PST (automated).
Ari: Ok, will wait for invoice then merge after Jordan gives OK — thanks all :thumbsup:
Jordan: PR reviewed and merged; I reduced overlap with nightly-bench. Good to proceed.
Sasha: TF applied and labels set: `demo/overnight` & `team/demo-redwood`. Monitoring allocation now. :eyes:
Lucas: Verified 4 A100s are reserved and live; nightly-bench adjusted down to 2 GPUs. All set for the demo. Good luck! :rocket:
